GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 370.05 (5 Mar 46) GC
(SCAPIN - 795)
APO 500
5 March 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Repatriation of Koreans Aboard Vessel Kizan Maru.
1. The Japanese Repatriation vessel Kizan Maru is now in Manila undergoing minor repairs. It is expected to arrive at Kure in the near future.
2. Aboard the vessel Keizan Maru are 16 Korean civilian repatriates.
3. The Imperial Japanese Government will receive care for the Korean repatriates, and transport them to a suitable port for embarkation on a repatriation vessel bound for Korea.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
B. M. FITCH
Brigadier General, AGD
Adjutant General
